description.p: Weather Radar shows the rain radar for Germany on a map, animated from the past hour to two hours ahead, based on the radar nowcast that the Deutscher Wetterdienst publishes as open data.
Weather Radar is an independent project and not affiliated with the Deutscher Wetterdienst. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

ul.li: Save places as pins on the map: tap a pin to see its 2-hour rain forecast, and rename or delete places from the pin or from the new places list.
Add places by searching for a city or town, at your current location, or by choosing a spot on the map.
Choose the place shown at startup in the new Preferences, which now also hold the playback speed.
Your location is remembered and shown as a pin right away.
"Reload Radar" moved to the main menu (Ctrl+R) to make room in the header.
Animated rain radar from one hour ago to two hours ahead, with a time bar to scrub through it or play it.
Step through the radar times with Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right.
Show your own location on the map.
See whether rain is coming in the next two hours: a sentence like “Rain starts in 35 min” and a bar chart for your location or the map centre.
A banner tells when the radar data is out of date, and opening the app shows the last radar data at once.
The About dialog and GNOME Software link to Liberapay, where you can support development.
The About dialog shows what is new in this version.
Radar playback is now smooth, fading between frames, and its speed can be set to slow, normal or fast in the main menu.
On narrow screens the map scale no longer covers the map attribution; the scale shows kilometres only.
